test_title: PYST 13 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
6 Which of the following sentences uses the word "tear" with the **same meaning** as in the following sentence?

"A single tear rolled down her cheek"

options.text: He carefully tried not to tear the delicate fabric.
The little girl's tear brought her mother running.
Be careful not to tear the pages of the old book.
The sharp edge of the paper can easily tear when handled roughly.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tear"** in the given sentence refers to a drop of liquid that comes from the eyes, usually due to emotions such as sadness or joy. (आंसू)
 
 
• **Example:** A tear escaped her eye when she heard the heartwarming story.
 
 
• The correct word **"tear"** (आंसू) is used in the same sense in option 2, as it refers to the liquid drop from the eye caused by emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** The little girl’s tear brought her mother running.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** He carefully tried not to tear the delicate fabric. (फाड़ना): Here, "tear" means to rip or split something apart.
 
 
• **Example:** Be cautious when handling the old tapestry to avoid tearing it.
 
 
• **Option 3:** Be careful not to tear the pages of the old book. (फाड़ना): Again, "tear" means to rip or damage something by pulling it apart.
 
 
• **Example:** The fragile pages of the manuscript can easily tear if mishandled.
 
 
• **Option 4:** The sharp edge of the paper can easily tear when handled roughly. (फाड़ना): Similar to options 1 and 3, here "tear" refers to the act of ripping or splitting apart.
 
 
• **Example:** The sharp corners of the paper caused it to tear unexpectedly.
 

39:T613,

The correct answer is option 4.
